content:
sara: Heads-up — customer reported being charged twice after a streaming reconnect that routed to a different region. small thread with logs below.
alex: ugh. can you paste the request/session ids + routing trace?
sara: sure — relevant bits:
```
request_id: r-03b9f4
session_id: s-9c7a1
route_history: us-west-2 -> fallback-eu-central-1
client_event: resume_stream
server_event: provision_tokens(confirmed=false)
```
logs show a `tool_call` truncated at EOF and then a resume that looks like a fresh session.
priya: thinking out loud — our provisional accounting marks tokens on the original backend before final ack. if resume goes to another backend, both sides may have provisional/confirmed lifecycle and we end up counting twice.
kyle: this rings true. truncated toolcalls are special: we create a new toolcall id on retry if we don't get a confirm. that can look like two distinct toolcalls for the ledger.
tom: console UX is confusing here. customers see two small token spikes and assume double-bill. we should show provisional vs confirmed in the per-route timeline.
alex: short-term mitigation: keep session affinity on handoff for X seconds so a resume prefers the same shard unless it's unhealthy. longer-term: change ledger to dedupe on session_id+prefix hash.
sara: is there an easy query to surface affected customers? I can run a scan by session_id patterns.
priya: yes — run `select * from token_events where session_id = 's-9c7a1' order by ts` and look for provisional=true rows on different hostnames.
sara: did that and attached sample rows (sanitized) — two provisional rows, one confirmed later. both were charged in provisional bucket currently shown in console as final.
devops-bot: deployment status: fallback-routing-hotfix v2 rolled to canary (3 nodes) — no errors.
kyle: question — do we also see toolcall truncation cases in the streaming traces? if the toolcall truncated, the token attribution might not have the `confirm_toolcall` event.
priya: correct. if we lose the confirm event, our reconciler marks one side provisional forever until a cleanup job. that's the bug.
tom: UX idea: show a small amber band in the per-route token chart "provisional credits pending (N)" with hover tooltip linking trace id.
alex: agree. also add a small note in rollout UI when enabling cross-region fallback: "may increase provisional tokens during failover".
sara: i'll open a quick internal bug and add affected customer list. can we prioritize a reconciler fix + console flag? customers hit billing team right now.
priya: i'll take the reconciler patch (dedupe by session+prefix) and run a staging job to backfill confirmed events.
kyle: i'll add a telemetry metric: counter.provisional_double_credit with tags route_from/route_to.
alex: we'll pair on the console change — tom, can you mock the amber band copy? two-line max.
tom: "Provisional credits pending: some tokens are tentatively reserved during routing/fallback. They will reconcile automatically or be attributed after confirm." (shortened in UI)
sara: thanks — filing bug and pinging CS + billing. will update thread with customer timeline.
priya: low-risk rollout: reconciler behind a feature flag, console toggled per-org.
sara: perfect. closing loop — will post postmortem if we hit billing regressions. :thumbsup
